findings.title: The claimed R02 lifecycle qualification is failing and does not exercise the governed resubmission transition
findings.reproduction: At exact reviewed state 9ad3d4e7ff8ae6f5698c0845ea3fb69c188dcb64, run `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m unittest -v tests.foundation.test_recoveryctl.GovernanceRecoveryTests.test_b02_scope_addendum_is_exact_commit_bound_and_fail_closed tests.foundation.test_recoveryctl.GovernanceRecoveryTests.test_b02_scope_addendum_rejects_stale_forked_and_wrong_candidates_without_mutation tests.foundation.test_recoveryctl.GovernanceRecoveryTests.test_b02_scope_addendum_rejects_semantic_authority_substitutions_without_mutation tests.foundation.test_recoveryctl.GovernanceRecoveryTests.test_b02_post_gcr_adverse_state_and_exact_r02_lineage_bridge`. The first three tests pass, but `test_b02_post_gcr_adverse_state_and_exact_r02_lineage_bridge` errors in its initial `validate_supplement` call with `Supplemental recovery evidence must name the current codex branch`. `b02_scope_clone` creates a bundle containing HEAD, the clone is detached, and the fixture creates branch `codex/b02-scope-fixture`; immutable R01 evidence and submission history are bound to `codex/w1-windows-local-runtime`. In addition, the new test calls `supplement_evidence_document` directly and never invokes the real `supplement-resubmit` transition required by R01 remediation. This disproves the evidence statements that all 32 recovery tests pass and that the required adverse-R01-to-R02 lifecycle is covered.
